precipice.line: A stone's throw from the precipice, paused
precipice.lineNext: Did he jump or did he fall as he gazed into the maw of the morning mist?
stanza: A stone's throw from the precipice, paused
Did he jump or did he fall as he gazed into the maw of the morning mist?
Did he raise both fists and say, "To hell with this" and just let the rock roll?
